entries.reason: Same test (178): a RETURN that succeeds ends the task, so the arm where RESP is NORMAL is never executed.

`IF WS-CICS-RESP NOT = DFHRESP(NORMAL)` after `RETURN TRANSID('OMEN') COMMAREA(COMMUNICATION-AREA) LENGTH(1)` (170-176): RETURN never comes back on success, so the test runs only when RETURN itself fails. The COMMAREA is the 1-byte working-storage COMMUNICATION-AREA (inside 0-32763, a non-zero address). IBM's RETURN conditions (https://www.ibm.com/docs/en/cics-ts/6.x?topic=summary-return) are INVREQ 1 (TRANSID in a program with no terminal), 2 (CHANNEL, COMMAREA or IMMEDIATE below the highest logical level), 4 (APPC logical unit), 8, 30, 200 and 203 (INPUTMSG, first-stage PLT, DPL, CHANNEL: none named here), LENGERR 11 and 26 (COMMAREA length outside 0-32763, a zero COMMAREA address with a non-zero length) and CHANNELERR 1. BNKMENU is the program of terminal transaction OMEN (T001; no program in the corpus LINKs or XCTLs to it, so it is the highest logical level), and the names are MOVEd constants. Assumption to review: the terminal is not an APPC logical unit (INVREQ 4).
